tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. schema.name: SendMessage
schema.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

6	
7	## 构思
8	
9	### 要解决什么问题
10	
11	开发板接 HDMI 显示器时，能在板端本地查看 WeakNet 的诊断状态，不依赖
12	远程 SSH 或云端。这是根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）。
13	
14	### 为什么不走 OpenSpec change
15	
16	1. 这是**探索性代码骨架**，不是已批准的产品表面。按 CLAUDE.md 铁律，
17	   没有 approved requirement、真实消费者和可观测命令的接口属于 orphan，
18	   不该走正式变更流程。
19	2. 用户明确指示「不用新开工作流。直接开始实现基本的代码结构」。
20	3. 代码放在独立目录 `qt_dashboard/`，不接入根构建，不修改任何现有文件，
21	   对主项目零影响。
22	
23	### 备选方案与取舍
24	
25	| 方案 | 取舍 |
26	|------|------|
27	| 复用 `client/weaknet_client.h` C API | **选它**。29KB 封装已就绪，50+ 只读函数，返回 JSON |

31	| QPainter 自绘 + 渲染到 QImage | **选它**。可像素级单测，无显示器也能验证 |
32	| 接入根 CMakeLists.txt | 弃。看板是可选界面，不该拖累主部署产物构建 |
33	
34	## 实现方式
35	
36	### 新增文件（全部在独立目录，未改动任何既有文件）

40	├── README.md                  设计决定与验证状态

# Qt 看板代码骨架与完整调用链

> 日期：2026-11-05
> 分类：探索 / 工作流外实施
> 结果：调用链已打通并**在本机完成完整编译、链接、启动验证**；ARM64 交叉编译与板端运行未做

## 构思

### 要解决什么问题

开发板接 HDMI 显示器时，能在板端本地查看 WeakNet 的诊断状态，不依赖
远程 SSH 或云端。这是根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）。

### 为什么不走 OpenSpec change

1. 这是**探索性代码骨架**，不是已批准的产品表面。按 CLAUDE.md 铁律，
   没有 approved requirement、真实消费者和可观测命令的接口属于 orphan，
   不该走正式变更流程。
2. 用户明确指示「不用新开工作流。直接开始实现基本的代码结构」，
   后续又明确「把第一第二部做了，然后第三步等显示器；不用新开工作流」。
3. 代码放在独立目录 `qt_dashboard/`，不接入根构建，不修改任何现有文件，
   对主项目零影响。

### 备选方案与取舍

| 方案 | 取舍 |
|------|------|
| 复用 `client/weaknet_client.h` C API | **选它**。29KB 封装已就绪，50+ 只读函数，返回 JSON |
| 自己实现 D-Bus 客户端 | 弃。`weaknet_cli` 之外再写一套是重复 |
| 引入 nlohmann/json | 弃。全仓不用第三方 JSON，`net_info.cpp:15` 记录了该决定 |
| 引入 Qt Charts | 弃。板端无 `libqt5charts5`；且无法脱离显示器测试 |
| QPainter 自绘 + 渲染到 QImage | **选它**。可像素级单测，无显示器也能验证 |
| 接入根 CMakeLists.txt | 弃。看板是可选界面，不该拖累主部署产物构建 |
| 同步 D-Bus 调用放 UI 线程 | 弃。服务端忙时会冻结界面，必须有后台线程 |

## 实现方式

### 新增文件（全部在独立目录，未改动任何既有文件）

```
qt_dashboard/                          约 3127 行
├── README.md                  设计决定与验证状态
├── CMakeLists.txt             139 行，独立 project，三 target
├── main.cpp                   入口，QCommandLineParser
├── data/                      ← 不依赖 Qt
│   ├── json_reader.hpp/cpp    178 / 478 行，路径式查找 + 根数组支持
│   ├── dashboard_data.hpp/cpp 301 / 235 行，POD + 解析
│   └── data_source.hpp/cpp    152 / 197 行，调 libweaknet + 缓冲扩容
├── ui/                        ← 依赖 Qt
│   ├── line_chart_widget.hpp/cpp  106 / 208 行，QPainter 折线图
│   ├── data_fetch_thread.hpp/cpp  115 / 120 行，QThread 后台取数
│   └── main_window.hpp/cpp        116 / 336 行，主窗口
└── tests/
    └── test_json_reader.cpp   385 行，30 个用例
```

### 调用链

```
main.cpp   QApplication + 命令行
  └── MainWindow                 顶栏 / 维度列表 / 趋势图 / 诊断栏
        ├── DataFetchThread      QThread，后台取数（禁止在 UI 线程调 D-Bus）
        │     └── DataSource     唯一直接调用 libweaknet 的地方
        │           └── weaknet_get_*()  ← client/weaknet_client.h
        ├── LineChartWidget      QPainter 自绘折线图
        └── parse_xxx()          JSON → POD（纯函数，可单测）
```

### 关键决策

**1. JSON 样本逐字取自服务端代码**

测试里的每一段 JSON 都来自真实序列化代码，不是臆造：

| 样本 | 来源 |
|------|------|
| 完整快照 | `server/include/assurance/legacy_adapter.hpp:162-227` |
| 无快照 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:916-917` |
| 快照过期 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:919-921` |
| 历史数组 | `server/src/database_manager.cpp:703-740` |
| 历史不可用 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:1530` |
| 诊断事实 | `server/include/assurance/diagnosis_engine.hpp:44-85` |

这样服务端改字段名时测试会红，而不是等接上显示器才发现界面空白。

**2. 核对真实 JSON 形状时纠正了四处臆断**

| 字段 | 猜测 | 实际出处 |
|------|------|---------|
| 历史时间戳 | `timestamp_ms`（数字） | `ts` 是**字符串**（`database_manager.cpp:704`） |
| 历史分数 | `display_score` | `score` / `overall_score`（`:720-721`） |
| 诊断置信度 | `double [0,1]` | **字符串枚举** `HIGH`/`MEDIUM`/`LOW`（`diagnosis_engine.hpp:49`） |
| `excluded_causes` | `vector<string>` | `vector<{cause,reason}>`（`:65-66`） |

**3. 枚举值也猜错了**

`server/include/assurance/health_state.hpp:15-38` 的真实取值：

```cpp
enum class HealthState { GOOD, DEGRADED, BAD, UNKNOWN };
// coverage: FULL_FOR_PROFILE / PARTIAL / NONE
```

原设计写的是 `HEALTHY` / `FAILED` 和 `FULL`，**全错**。已修正到
header、`.cpp` 和测试断言（含注释）。

**4. schema v2 的降级形状需要单独处理**

服务端在无快照 / 快照过期时返回**顶层** `state`/`coverage`/`reason`，
没有 `overall` 对象。`parse_experience()` 先检测 `overall.state` 是否存在，
不存在就按降级形状解析，并置 `unavailable_reason`。看板据此显示
「等待评估」而不是 0 分。

**5. 服务端按 `ts DESC` 返回，解析时翻转为正序**

`queryHistory()` 的 SQL 是 `ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`，最新在前。
`parse_history()` 在末尾 `std::reverse`，让图表从左到右是时间正序。

**6. 缓冲区自动扩容，绝不把截断当成功**

C API 不报告截断。取数层先给 8 KB，用 `JsonReader::valid()` 判断完整性，
不合法就翻倍重试，上限 4 MB。截断的 JSON 一律视为失败。

**7. `JsonReader` 增加根数组支持**

原设计只从 `{` 开始查找，但 `GetHistory` 返回顶层数组。补了
`rootIsArray()` / `getRootObjectArray()` / `rootArraySize()` 三个方法。

板端 `apt install qtbase5-dev` 会级联移除 200+ KDE 包，已排除：

```text

    -c <每个 .cpp>

# Qt 看板代码骨架

> 日期：2026-11-05
> 分类：探索 / 工作流外实施
> 结果：部分完成（数据层已验证，UI 层未编译）

## 构思

### 要解决什么问题

开发板接 HDMI 显示器时，能在板端本地查看 WeakNet 的诊断状态，不依赖
远程 SSH 或云端。这是根目录 `内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 方向一（路径 A1）。

### 为什么不走 OpenSpec change

1. 这是**探索性代码骨架**，不是已批准的产品表面。按 CLAUDE.md 铁律，
   没有 approved requirement、真实消费者和可观测命令的接口属于 orphan，
   不该走正式变更流程。
2. 用户明确指示「不用新开工作流。直接开始实现基本的代码结构」。
3. 代码放在独立目录 `qt_dashboard/`，不接入根构建，不修改任何现有文件，
   对主项目零影响。

### 备选方案与取舍

| 方案 | 取舍 |
|------|------|
| 复用 `client/weaknet_client.h` C API | **选它**。29KB 封装已就绪，50+ 只读函数，返回 JSON |
| 自己实现 D-Bus 客户端 | 弃。`weaknet_cli` 之外再写一套是重复 |
| 引入 nlohmann/json | 弃。全仓不用第三方 JSON，`net_info.cpp:15` 记录了该决定 |
| 引入 Qt Charts | 弃。板端无 `libqt5charts5`；且无法脱离显示器测试 |
| QPainter 自绘 + 渲染到 QImage | **选它**。可像素级单测，无显示器也能验证 |
| 接入根 CMakeLists.txt | 弃。看板是可选界面，不该拖累主部署产物构建 |

## 实现方式

### 新增文件（全部在独立目录，未改动任何既有文件）

```
qt_dashboard/
├── README.md                  设计决定与验证状态
├── CMakeLists.txt             独立 project，默认不带 UI
├── data/
│   ├── json_reader.hpp        轻量 JSON 读取器（路径式查找）
│   ├── json_reader.cpp        422 行，15 个方法
│   ├── dashboard_data.hpp     POD 结构体 + 解析函数声明
│   └── dashboard_data.cpp     234 行，JSON → POD
├── ui/
│   ├── line_chart_widget.hpp  QPainter 自绘折线图
│   └── line_chart_widget.cpp  绘制与控件解耦，可渲染到 QImage
└── tests/
    └── test_json_reader.cpp   30 个用例
```

### 关键决策

**1. JSON 样本逐字取自服务端代码**

测试里的每一段 JSON 都来自真实序列化代码，不是臆造：

| 样本 | 来源 |
|------|------|
| 完整快照 | `server/include/assurance/legacy_adapter.hpp:162-227` |
| 无快照 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:916-917` |
| 快照过期 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:919-921` |
| 历史数组 | `server/src/database_manager.cpp:703-740` |
| 历史不可用 | `server/src/dbus_service.cpp:1530` |
| 诊断事实 | `server/include/assurance/diagnosis_engine.hpp:44-85` |

这样服务端改字段名时测试会红，而不是等接上显示器才发现界面空白。

**2. 核对真实 JSON 形状时纠正了两处臆断**

- `HistoryPoint` 原本按 `timestamp_ms`（数字）设计，实际服务端 `ts` 是
  **字符串**（`"2026-11-06 10:23:10"`），分数字段是 `score` / `overall_score`
  而非 `display_score`。已改。
- `DiagnosisSnapshot::confidence` 原本按 `double [0,1]` 设计，实际是
  **字符串枚举** `HIGH` / `MEDIUM` / `LOW`。已改。
- `excluded_causes` 是对象数组（`{cause,reason}`），不是字符串数组。已改。

**3. schema v2 的降级形状需要单独处理**

服务端在无快照 / 快照过期时返回**顶层** `state`/`coverage`/`reason`，
没有 `overall` 对象。`parse_experience()` 先检测 `overall.state` 是否存在，
不存在就按降级形状解析，并置 `unavailable_reason`。看板据此显示
「等待评估」而不是 0 分。

**4. 服务端按 `ts DESC` 返回，解析时翻转为正序**

`queryHistory()` 的 SQL 是 `ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`，最新在前。
`parse_history()` 在末尾 `std::reverse`，让图表从左到右是时间正序。

**5. `JsonReader` 增加根数组支持**

原设计只从 `{` 开始查找，但 `GetHistory` 返回顶层数组。补了
`rootIsArray()` / `getRootObjectArray()` / `rootArraySize()` 三个方法。

### 验证手段

```bash
# 数据层独立编译（零警告）
cd qt_dashboard
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -c data/json_reader.cpp -o /tmp/json_reader.o
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -c data/dashboard_data.cpp -o /tmp/dashboard_data.o

# 单元测试
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I. tests/test_json_reader.cpp \
    data/json_reader.cpp data/dashboard_data.cpp \
    -lgtest -lgtest_main -lpthread -o /tmp/qt_dashboard_tests
/tmp/qt_dashboard_tests

# CMake 全流程
cmake -S qt_dashboard -B /tmp/build-qt-dash -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build /tmp/build-qt-dash -j$(nproc)
ctest --test-dir /tmp/build-qt-dash --output-on-failure
```

## 结果

### 已完成

| 项 | 状态 |
|----|------|
| 数据层编译 | ✅ 零警告 |
| 数据层单测 | ✅ 30/30 通过 |
| CMake 配置 + 构建 + ctest | ✅ 全流程跑通 |
| 服务端 JSON 形状核对 | ✅ 逐字段对照真实序列化代码 |

### 未完成（明确边界）

| 项 | 原因 |
|----|------|
| UI 层编译验证 | 本机无 Qt 开发包；板端装 `qtbase5-dev` 会级联移除 200+ KDE 包（11-05 板端复测确认：`Remv` 仅 1 条但连坐 200+，且无 gles 版 dev 包可替代） |
| 上板运行 | 无 HDMI 显示器 |
| `MainWindow` | 骨架阶段未写，只做了数据层 + 一个图表控件 |

**`ui/line_chart_widget.cpp` 从未被编译器检查过。** 这是当前最大的不确定性：
代码可能有语法错误或 Qt API 误用。接入真实构建前必须先在有 Qt 开发包的
机器上编译一次。

### 后续

1. 找一台有 Qt 开发包的环境编译 UI 层（板端直装已被 11-05 实测排除，
   只剩宿主机 sysroot 交叉编译或 Docker 容器）
2. 写 `MainWindow`，串起 D-Bus → 解析 → 控件
3. 接显示器后做 EGLFS / X11 实机验证

是否升格为正式 OpenSpec change：**待显示器到位、UI 层跑通后再评估**。
现在代码尚未验证，没有资格谈验收。

The recursive dependency resolution gives178 packages including libc6 from bullseye — that's a problem because extracting libc62.31 into the staging root is unnecessary (and potentially dangerous if someone uses LD_LIBRARY_PATH). Actually since we only use `-Wl,-rpath-link` and headers, it's fine; but downloading178 debs is heavy (~200MB+).

Better approach: don't recursively resolve everything. Just take the direct set of packages we actually need. From the previous session's work, the needed set was:
- qtbase5-dev (headers + .so symlinks + .prl)
- qtbase5-dev-tools (moc, uic, rcc)
- libqt5core5a, libqt5gui5, libqt5widgets5, libqt5dbus5, libqt5network5 (runtime libs for linking)
- indirect: libmd4c0, libdouble-conversion3, libicu67, libpcre2-16-0 (these are the ones that were missing at link time)
- plus their transitive runtime deps needed for the binary to RUN (not just link)

Rather than blindly recursing178 packages, a smarter design: resolve recursively but SKIP packages that the host already provides at an equal-or-newer version. But version comparison across Ubuntu24.04 vs Debian11 is tricky.

Actually, let me step back and think about design priorities:

The purpose of this script is: **make the Qt build reproducible on this host (Ubuntu24.04 amd64)**. The cleanest approach that respects "don't install to system":
- Download a curated list of packages (not full recursion)

# 从 mirrors.aliyun.com/debian 下载 amd64 包到 /tmp/qtstage/root

moc ui/data_fetch_thread.hpp -o moc_data_fetch_thread.cpp

g++ -std=c++17 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -I. -I../client -I$QTINC ... -c <每个.cpp>
g++ -o weaknet_dashboard *.o -L$QTLIB -lQt5Widgets -lQt5Gui -lQt5Core \
    -L<build-x86>/client/lib -lweaknet -Wl,-rpath-link,$QTLIB
```

的并发下载机制。以后遇到类似环境可直接走「curl 单包 + dpkg-deb -x」。

## 本次完成的工作

**第一步：打通调用链（已完成）**

`qt_dashboard/` 现有 16 个文件、2988 行代码，调用链路完整：

```
main.cpp → MainWindow → DataFetchThread(QThread) → DataSource → weaknet_get_*()
```

编译过程中实际发现 **3 个真实 bug**：缺少 `#include <QTimer>`，以及两处把 `std::string` 传给 `QString` 时没有隐式转换。此外还发现服务端枚举值我全部猜错了（`HEALTHY/FAILED` 实际应为 `GOOD/DEGRADED/BAD/UNKNOWN`，`FULL` 实际应为 `FULL_FOR_PROFILE`），以及 4 处 JSON 字段（`ts` 是字符串而非数字、`confidence` 是字符串枚举等）也与实际不符。所有这些问题都已经按真实序列化代码修正，并在测试中添加了出处行号。

**第二步：编译环境（x86 已解决，ARM64 未解决）**

在没有 Qt 开发包的情况下，我通过“下载 deb 包并解压到临时目录”的方式，在宿主机上完成了完整验证：moc 3/3、编译零警告、链接成功（365 KB，没有 undefined reference）、在 `offscreen` 下启动正常。

不过晚些时候做 dry-run 复测时发现一个重要事实：**宿主机 Ubuntu 24.04 直接安装 `qtbase5-dev` 不会卸载任何包（`Remv` = 0）**，和开发板的情况完全不同。开发板之所以危险，是因为 `libqt5gui5` 与 `libqt5gui5-gles` 互斥，而 KDE 依赖 gles 变体；宿主机没有安装 KDE，所以不存在这个冲突。因此，我当时的 deb 包解压方案其实是在绕路。这条更正已经写进三处文档，避免下次重复绕路。

**没有解决的**：ARM64 交叉编译。cross sysroot 里没有 Qt dev 头文件，arm64 的包只能从 bullseye 源安装，而这正是会连带卸载 KDE 包的那一套。因此，“宿主机安装 Qt”只能解决 x86 验证，不能用于构建开发板端产物。

文档已经同步到三处：`内核模块技术栈引入讨论.md` 的 4.8 节、`qt_dashboard/README.md`、`openspec/tasks/2026-11-05-qt-dashboard-skeleton.md`。

**距离验收还差三步**：ARM64 构建环境、HDMI 显示器、真实 D-Bus 取数验证。第三步需要前两步都就绪。

工作区状态：`qt_dashboard/` 和任务记录都是未跟踪的新文件，讨论文档是已修改状态；`CLAUDE.md` 与 `skills/coaching-resume-bullets/*` 是其他会话的改动，没有触碰。

# ============================================================================
# cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake
# 宿主机裸机原生交叉编译工具链（x86_64 宿主机直接编译 -> aarch64 目标板）
#
# 核心设计：
# 1. 完全脱离 Docker 容器与 QEMU 模拟，直接在宿主机 x86 CPU 上运行原生 Clang，
#    吃满全部 CPU 核心并行编译 (-j$(nproc))，全量构建从 15 分钟降至 ~30 秒。
# 2. 通过 --sysroot=/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64 与 --gcc-toolchain 指向从
#    Bullseye 提取的 GCC 10 / glibc 2.31 运行时树，彻底隔绝宿主机高版本 glibc 2.39，
#    产出的 ELF 最高只依赖 GLIBC_2.30 及以下，与开发板 100% 二进制兼容。
# ============================================================================

set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Linux)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR aarch64)

set(TARGET_TRIPLE "aarch64-linux-gnu")
set(SYSROOT_DIR "/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64")

set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER clang)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_TARGET ${TARGET_TRIPLE})

set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER clang++)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_TARGET ${TARGET_TRIPLE})

set(CMAKE_SYSROOT ${SYSROOT_DIR})
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH ${SYSROOT_DIR})

# 关键：--gcc-toolchain=${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr 让 Clang 使用 sysroot 内的 GCC 10 (crtbeginS.o / libstdc++)，
# 而不去捡宿主机 Ubuntu 的 GCC 13 (glibc 2.39)。
set(COMMON_CROSS_FLAGS "--target=${TARGET_TRIPLE} --sysroot=${SYSROOT_DIR} --gcc-toolchain=${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr -Wno-unused-command-line-argument")

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_INIT "${COMMON_CROSS_FLAGS} -isystem ${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/include")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT "${COMMON_CROSS_FLAGS} -stdlib=libstdc++ -isystem ${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/include")

set(COMMON_LINKER_FLAGS "${COMMON_CROSS_FLAGS} -L${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/lib -L${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu -L${SYSROOT_DIR}/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu -Wl,-rpath-link,${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/lib -Wl,-rpath-link,${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu -Wl,-rpath-link,${SYSROOT_DIR}/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu")

set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT "${COMMON_LINKER_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT "${COMMON_LINKER_FLAGS}")

# 资源搜索隔离策略
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)

# Pkg-config 交叉编译环境变量注入
set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_DIR} "")
set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR} "${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig:${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig:${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/share/pkgconfig")
set(ENV{PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR} "${SYSROOT_DIR}")

# 私有依赖路径映射
set(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT "${SYSROOT_DIR}/opt/weaknet-openssl-1.1" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(WEAKNET_CURL_SYSROOT "${SYSROOT_DIR}/opt/weaknet-libcurl" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh
#
# 从 Debian bullseye 源下载 arm64 的 Qt5 开发包，解压进 ARM64 交叉编译 sysroot。
#
# ## 为什么需要这个脚本
#
# 宿主机（Ubuntu 24.04）可以 `apt install qtbase5-dev` 直接验证 x86 构建，
# 但 ARM64 产物必须用 /opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64，而那个 sysroot 是**解压树**
# 不是 apt 系统，里面没有 Qt 头文件。
#
# 板端直装 qtbase5-dev 已排除（libqt5gui5 与 libqt5gui5-gles 互斥，会拆 200+ KDE 包），
# 但这里下载的是**解压到 sysroot**，不安装到任何运行中的系统，无此副作用。
#
# ## 安全边界
#
# 1. 只解压到 $SYSROOT，不碰开发板、不碰宿主机 /usr
# 2. **排除 libc6 / libgcc-s1 / 核心系统包** —— sysroot 里的 glibc 2.31 是
#    交叉编译正确性的根基，被 bullseye 包覆盖会破坏已有的 OpenSSL/curl 构建
# 3. 只解压运行库与 dev 包，不装 apt/dpkg 元数据
#
# ## 用法
#
#   ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh            # 默认 sysroot
#   SYSROOT=/path/to/sysroot ./fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh      # 覆盖
#   ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh --dry-run  # 只打印不下载
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

SYSROOT="${SYSROOT:-/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64}"
MIRROR="${MIRROR:-https://mirrors.aliyun.com/debian}"
SUITE="${SUITE:-bullseye}"
ARCH="${ARCH:-arm64}"
WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-/tmp/qt-arm64-sysroot}"

DRY_RUN=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
        -h|--help) sed -n '2,30p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
        *) echo "未知参数: $arg" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done

log() { printf '[qt-arm64] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '[qt-arm64] 错误: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ -d "$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$ARCH-linux-gnu" ] || die "sysroot 不像 bullseye 树: $SYSROOT"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 必须保留的包：这些是 sysroot 的地基，绝不能被 Debian 包覆盖
#
# 覆盖 libc6 会导致：交叉编译链原本链接的是经过验证的 2.31，
# 被替换后行为不可预期；且已有的 OpenSSL / curl 私有构建也可能失效。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROTECTED_PKGS=(
    libc6 libc-bin libc-dev-bin libgcc-s1 gcc-10-base libstdc++6
    libcrypt1 zlib1g libssl1.1 libssl-dev
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 需要的 Qt 包（只含编译看板必需的）
#
# qtbase5-dev      头文件 + .prl + mkspecs
# qtbase5-dev-tools  moc / uic / rcc
# libqt5*5        运行库
# libqt5*5-dev    各模块的 .so 符号链接
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ROOT_PKGS=(
    qtbase5-dev
    qtbase5-dev-tools
    libqt5core5a
    libqt5gui5
    libqt5widgets5
    libqt5dbus5
    libqt5network5
    libqt5concurrent5
    libqt5printsupport5
    libqt5sql5
    libqt5test5
    libqt5xml5
)

mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
cd "$WORKDIR"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 拉取包索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PKGS_GZ="$WORKDIR/Packages.gz"
if [ ! -s "$PKGS_GZ" ]; then
    log "下载包索引 ($ARCH/$SUITE)..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$PKGS_GZ" \
        "$MIRROR/dists/$SUITE/main/binary-$ARCH/Packages.gz" \
        || die "包索引下载失败"
fi
log "索引大小: $(du -h "$PKGS_GZ" | cut -f1)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 递归解析依赖，算出完整包集（排除受保护包）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "解析依赖树..."
mapfile -t DEB_LIST < <(python3 - "$PKGS_GZ" "${ROOT_PKGS[@]}" <<'PYEOF'
import gzip, re, sys

pkgs_gz = sys.argv[1]
roots = sys.argv[2:]

protected = {
    "libc6", "libc-bin", "libc-dev-bin", "libgcc-s1", "gcc-10-base",
    "libstdc++6", "libcrypt1", "zlib1g", "libssl1.1", "libssl-dev",
    # 这些是 sysroot 已有且不该被动的基础件
    "base-files", "dpkg", "debconf", "ucf", "perl", "perl-base",
    "perl-modules-5.32", "libperl5.32", "coreutils", "sensible-utils",
    "x11-common", "lsb-base", "fontconfig-config", "shared-mime-info",
}

pools = {}
cur = {}
with gzip.open(pkgs_gz, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if not line:
            if "Package" in cur and "Filename" in cur:
                pools[cur["Package"]] = (cur["Filename"], cur.get("Depends", ""))
            cur = {}
            continue
        if line.startswith("Package:"):
            cur["Package"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Filename:"):
            cur["Filename"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Depends:"):
            cur["Depends"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()

seen = set()
order = []

def resolve(name):
    if name in seen or name in protected:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    if name not in pools:
        return
    fname, deps = pools[name]
    order.append((name, fname))
    if not deps:
        return
    for part in deps.split(","):
        alt = part.split("|")[0].strip()
        dep = re.sub(r"\s*\(.*?\)", "", alt).strip().split(":")[0]
        if dep:
            resolve(dep)

for r in roots:
    resolve(r)

for name, fname in order:
    print(f"{name}\t{fname}")
PYEOF
)

[ "${#DEB_LIST[@]}" -gt 0 ] || die "依赖解析结果为空"

log "需下载 ${#DEB_LIST[@]} 个包（已排除受保护包）"
if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    for entry in "${DEB_LIST[@]}"; do
        printf '  %s\n' "${entry%%$'\t'*}"
    done
    log "dry-run 结束，未下载"
    exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 下载并解压
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FAILED=0
for entry in "${DEB_LIST[@]}"; do
    pkg="${entry%%$'\t'*}"
    rel="${entry##*$'\t'}"
    deb="$WORKDIR/$(basename "$rel")"

    if [ ! -f "$deb" ]; then
        # 单包 curl 比 apt 并发下载快得多（实测 1.6 s/MB）
        if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "$deb" "$MIRROR/$rel"; then
            printf '  下载失败: %s\n' "$pkg" >&2
            FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
            continue
        fi
    fi

    # dpkg-deb -x 只解压文件，不执行任何 maintainer script
    if ! dpkg-deb -x "$deb" "$SYSROOT" 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  解压失败: %s\n' "$pkg" >&2
        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
        continue
    fi
    printf '  ok  %s\n' "$pkg"
done

if [ "$FAILED" -gt 0 ]; then
    die "$FAILED 个包失败"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 验证
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "验证安装结果..."

QTINC="$SYSROOT/usr/include/$ARCH-linux-gnu/qt5"
[ -d "$QTINC" ] || die "Qt 头文件目录不存在: $QTINC"

MOC="$SYSROOT/usr/lib/qt5/bin/moc"
if [ -x "$MOC" ]; then
    log "moc: $MOC"
else
    # 二进制是 arm64，宿主机无法执行；只要文件存在即可由 qemu 或交叉调用
    [ -f "$MOC" ] && log "moc 文件存在（arm64，宿主机不可直接执行）" \
        || log "警告: 未找到 moc"
fi

QTLIB="$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$ARCH-linux-gnu"
for lib in libQt5Core.so.5 libQt5Gui.so.5 libQt5Widgets.so.5; do
    [ -e "$QTLIB/$lib" ] && printf '  ok  %s\n' "$lib" \
        || printf '  缺失 %s\n' "$lib" >&2
done

log "完成。sysroot: $SYSROOT"
log "构建命令："
cat <<EOF

  cmake -S qt_dashboard -B build-qt-arm64 \\
    -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake \\
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \\
    -DWEAKN_DASHBOARD_WITH_UI=ON \\
    -DWEAKNET_CLIENT_LIB=<build-arm64>/client/lib/libweaknet.so
  cmake --build build-qt-arm64 -j1

EOF

#
#   ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh            # 默认 sysroot
#   SYSROOT=/path/to/sysroot ./fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh      # 覆盖
#   ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh --dry-run  # 只打印不下载
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

SYSROOT="${SYSROOT:-/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64}"
MIRROR="${MIRROR:-https://mirrors.aliyun.com/debian}"
SUITE="${SUITE:-bullseye}"
ARCH="${ARCH:-arm64}"
WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-/tmp/qt-arm64-sysroot}"

DRY_RUN=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
        -h|--help) sed -n '2,30p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
        *) echo "未知参数: $arg" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done

log() { printf '[qt-arm64] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '[qt-arm64] 错误: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ -d "$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$ARCH-linux-gnu" ] || die "sysroot 不像 bullseye 树: $SYSROOT"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 必须保留的包：这些是 sysroot 的地基，绝不能被 Debian 包覆盖
#
# 覆盖 libc6 会导致：交叉编译链原本链接的是经过验证的 2.31，
# 被替换后行为不可预期；且已有的 OpenSSL / curl 私有构建也可能失效。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROTECTED_PKGS=(
    libc6 libc-bin libc-dev-bin libgcc-s1 gcc-10-base libstdc++6
    libcrypt1 zlib1g libssl1.1 libssl-dev
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 需要的 Qt 包（只含编译看板必需的）
#
# qtbase5-dev      头文件 + .prl + mkspecs
# qtbase5-dev-tools  moc / uic / rcc
# libqt5*5        运行库
# libqt5*5-dev    各模块的 .so 符号链接
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ROOT_PKGS=(
    qtbase5-dev
    qtbase5-dev-tools
    libqt5core5a
    libqt5gui5
    libqt5widgets5
    libqt5dbus5
    libqt5network5
    libqt5concurrent5
    libqt5printsupport5
    libqt5sql5
    libqt5test5
    libqt5xml5
)

mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
cd "$WORKDIR"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 拉取包索引
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PKGS_GZ="$WORKDIR/Packages.gz"
if [ ! -s "$PKGS_GZ" ]; then
    log "下载包索引 ($ARCH/$SUITE)..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$PKGS_GZ" \
        "$MIRROR/dists/$SUITE/main/binary-$ARCH/Packages.gz" \
        || die "包索引下载失败"
fi
log "索引大小: $(du -h "$PKGS_GZ" | cut -f1)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 递归解析依赖，算出完整包集（排除受保护包）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "解析依赖树..."
mapfile -t DEB_LIST < <(python3 - "$PKGS_GZ" "${ROOT_PKGS[@]}" <<'PYEOF'
import gzip, re, sys

pkgs_gz = sys.argv[1]
roots = sys.argv[2:]

protected = {
    "libc6", "libc-bin", "libc-dev-bin", "libgcc-s1", "gcc-10-base",
    "libstdc++6", "libcrypt1", "zlib1g", "libssl1.1", "libssl-dev",
    # 这些是 sysroot 已有且不该被动的基础件
    "base-files", "dpkg", "debconf", "ucf", "perl", "perl-base",
    "perl-modules-5.32", "libperl5.32", "coreutils", "sensible-utils",
    "x11-common", "lsb-base", "fontconfig-config", "shared-mime-info",
}

pools = {}
cur = {}
with gzip.open(pkgs_gz, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if not line:
            if "Package" in cur and "Filename" in cur:
                pools[cur["Package"]] = (cur["Filename"], cur.get("Depends", ""))
            cur = {}
            continue
        if line.startswith("Package:"):
            cur["Package"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Filename:"):
            cur["Filename"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Depends:"):
            cur["Depends"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()

seen = set()
order = []

def resolve(name):
    if name in seen or name in protected:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    if name not in pools:
        return
    fname, deps = pools[name]
    order.append((name, fname))
    if not deps:
        return
    for part in deps.split(","):
        alt = part.split("|")[0].strip()
        dep = re.sub(r"\s*\(.*?\)", "", alt).strip().split(":")[0]
        if dep:
            resolve(dep)

for r in roots:
    resolve(r)

for name, fname in order:
    print(f"{name}\t{fname}")
PYEOF
)

[ "${#DEB_LIST[@]}" -gt 0 ] || die "依赖解析结果为空"

log "需下载 ${#DEB_LIST[@]} 个包（已排除受保护包）"
if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    for entry in "${DEB_LIST[@]}"; do
        printf '  %s\n' "${entry%%$'\t'*}"
    done
    log "dry-run 结束，未下载"
    exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 下载并解压
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FAILED=0
for entry in "${DEB_LIST[@]}"; do
    pkg="${entry%%$'\t'*}"
    rel="${entry##*$'\t'}"
    deb="$WORKDIR/$(basename "$rel")"

    if [ ! -f "$deb" ]; then
        # 单包 curl 比 apt 并发下载快得多（实测 1.6 s/MB）
        if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "$deb" "$MIRROR/$rel"; then
            printf '  下载失败: %s\n' "$pkg" >&2
            FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
            continue
        fi
    fi

    # dpkg-deb -x 只解压文件，不执行任何 maintainer script
    if ! dpkg-deb -x "$deb" "$SYSROOT" 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  解压失败: %s\n' "$pkg" >&2
        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
        continue
    fi
    printf '  ok  %s\n' "$pkg"
done

if [ "$FAILED" -gt 0 ]; then
    die "$FAILED 个包失败"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 验证
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "验证安装结果..."

QTINC="$SYSROOT/usr/include/$ARCH-linux-gnu/qt5"
[ -d "$QTINC" ] || die "Qt 头文件目录不存在: $QTINC"

MOC="$SYSROOT/usr/lib/qt5/bin/moc"
if [ -x "$MOC" ]; then
    log "moc: $MOC"
else
    # 二进制是 arm64，宿主机无法执行；只要文件存在即可由 qemu 或交叉调用
    [ -f "$MOC" ] && log "moc 文件存在（arm64，宿主机不可直接执行）" \
        || log "警告: 未找到 moc"
fi

QTLIB="$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$ARCH-linux-gnu"
for lib in libQt5Core.so.5 libQt5Gui.so.5 libQt5Widgets.so.5; do
    [ -e "$QTLIB/$lib" ] && printf '  ok  %s\n' "$lib" \
        || printf '  缺失 %s\n' "$lib" >&2
done

log "完成。sysroot: $SYSROOT"
log "构建命令："
cat <<EOF

  cmake -S qt_dashboard -B build-qt-arm64 \\
    -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake \\
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \\
    -DWEAKN_DASHBOARD_WITH_UI=ON \\
    -DWEAKNET_CLIENT_LIB=<build-arm64>/client/lib/libweaknet.so
  cmake --build build-qt-arm64 -j1

EOF

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# qt_dashboard/tools/build-arm64.sh
#
# 为 ARM64 开发板构建 Qt 看板（宿主机原生交叉编译，不需要 Docker/QEMU 跑构建）。
#
# ## 关键技巧：moc 用 x86 的，编译器用 arm64 的
#
# Qt 的 moc 是**构建期工具**，它的产物 moc_*.cpp 只是把 Q_OBJECT 宏展开成
# 普通 C++ 源码，**与目标架构无关**。因此：
#
#   - moc 用宿主机 x86 版（qtbase5-dev-tools，apt 装，零卸载）
#   - 编译用 clang --target=aarch64-linux-gnu + sysroot
#
# 这样就不需要 qemu-user-static、不需要 binfmt 注册、不需要在容器里跑构建。
#
# 已验证：x86 moc 5.15.13 的产物交给 arm64 clang 编译，10/10 单元零警告通过；
# 链接产物 glibc 需求仅 GLIBC_2.17，远低于板端 2.31。
#
# ## 前置条件
#
#   1. sysroot 里有 arm64 的 Qt5 开发文件
#      → ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh
#   2. 宿主机有 x86 moc
#      → sudo apt install qtbase5-dev-tools   （8 个包，零卸载）
#   3. 已构建 arm64 的 libweaknet.so
#      → cmake -B build-arm64-native -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake
#
# ## 用法
#
#   ./qt_dashboard/tools/build-arm64.sh
#   BUILD_DIR=/tmp/my-build ./qt_dashboard/tools/build-arm64.sh
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

SYSROOT="${SYSROOT:-/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64}"
TRIPLE="${TRIPLE:-aarch64-linux-gnu}"
OUT="${BUILD_DIR:-$REPO_ROOT/build-qt-arm64}"
WEAKNET_LIB_DIR="${WEAKNET_LIB_DIR:-$REPO_ROOT/build-arm64-native/client/lib}"

QTINC="$SYSROOT/usr/include/$TRIPLE/qt5"
QTLIB="$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$TRIPLE"

log() { printf '[build-arm64] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '[build-arm64] 错误: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 前置检查：一次性说清缺什么，不要编译到一半才报错
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "前置检查..."

[ -d "$QTINC/QtWidgets" ] || die "sysroot 缺 Qt 头文件: $QTINC/QtWidgets
  先运行: ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh"

[ -e "$QTLIB/libQt5Widgets.so.5" ] || die "sysroot 缺 Qt 运行库: $QTLIB"

command -v moc >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "宿主机没有 moc
  先运行: sudo apt install qtbase5-dev-tools"

MOC_VERSION="$(moc -v 2>&1 | head -1)"
log "宿主机 moc: $MOC_VERSION"

[ -f "$WEAKNET_LIB_DIR/libweaknet.so" ] || die "缺 arm64 libweaknet.so: $WEAKNET_LIB_DIR
  先运行: cmake -B build-arm64-native -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake
          cmake --build build-arm64-native -j\$(nproc)"

command -v clang++ >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "缺 clang++"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 编译
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CXXFLAGS=(
    --target="$TRIPLE"
    --sysroot="$SYSROOT"
    --gcc-toolchain="$SYSROOT/usr"
    -stdlib=libstdc++
    -std=c++17
    -fPIC
    -Wall -Wextra
    -DQT_NO_DEBUG
    -I"$REPO_ROOT/qt_dashboard"
    -I"$REPO_ROOT/client"
    -I"$QTINC"
    -I"$QTINC/QtCore"
    -I"$QTINC/QtGui"
    -I"$QTINC/QtWidgets"
)

LDFLAGS=(
    --target="$TRIPLE"
    --sysroot="$SYSROOT"
    --gcc-toolchain="$SYSROOT/usr"
    -stdlib=libstdc++
)

mkdir -p "$OUT"
cd "$REPO_ROOT/qt_dashboard"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. moc：x86 工具，产物与架构无关
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "生成 moc..."
for h in line_chart_widget data_fetch_thread main_window; do
    moc "ui/$h.hpp" -o "$OUT/moc_$h.cpp" \
        || die "moc 失败: $h"
    log "  moc $h"
done

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 编译（-j1：QEMU/交叉环境下高并行度易出错，且单核即可快速完成）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "编译（串行，避免并行问题）..."
SOURCES=(
    data/json_reader
    data/dashboard_data
    data/data_source
    ui/line_chart_widget
    ui/data_fetch_thread
    ui/main_window
    main
)
OBJECTS=()

for src in "${SOURCES[@]}"; do
    base="$(basename "$src")"
    obj="$OUT/$base.o"
    if ! clang++ "${CXXFLAGS[@]}" -c "$src.cpp" -o "$obj" 2>"$OUT/$base.err"; then
        printf '[build-arm64] 编译失败: %s\n' "$src.cpp" >&2
        head -20 "$OUT/$base.err" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    OBJECTS+=("$obj")
    log "  $base"
done

for m in moc_line_chart_widget moc_data_fetch_thread moc_main_window; do
    obj="$OUT/$m.o"
    if ! clang++ "${CXXFLAGS[@]}" -c "$OUT/$m.cpp" -o "$obj" 2>"$OUT/$m.err"; then
        printf '[build-arm64] 编译失败: %s\n' "$m" >&2
        head -20 "$OUT/$m.err" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    OBJECTS+=("$obj")
    log "  $m"
done

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 链接
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "链接..."
clang++ "${LDFLAGS[@]}" -o "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" "${OBJECTS[@]}" \
    -L"$QTLIB" -lQt5Widgets -lQt5Gui -lQt5Core -lQt5DBus \
    -L"$WEAKNET_LIB_DIR" -lweaknet \
    -Wl,-rpath-link,"$QTLIB" \
    -Wl,-rpath-link,"$SYSROOT/lib/$TRIPLE" \
    || die "链接失败"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 验证产物
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "验证..."
file "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" | sed 's/^/  /'

MAX_GLIBC="$(readelf --version-info "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -o 'GLIBC_[0-9.]*' | sort -uV | tail -1)"
log "最高 glibc 需求: ${MAX_GLIBC:-未知}  （板端是 GLIBC_2.31）"

SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard")"
log "产物大小: $SIZE 字节"

cat <<EOF

[build-arm64] 完成: $OUT/weaknet_dashboard

部署到开发板：
  scp $OUT/weaknet_dashboard board:/tmp/
  ssh board 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen /tmp/weaknet_dashboard --help'

接显示器后（需要 /dev/dri 权限）：
  ssh board 'sudo QT_QPA_PLATFORM=eglfs /tmp/weaknet_dashboard'
EOF

# 前置检查：一次性说清缺什么，不要编译到一半才报错
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "前置检查..."

[ -d "$QTINC/QtWidgets" ] || die "sysroot 缺 Qt 头文件: $QTINC/QtWidgets
  先运行: ./qt_dashboard/tools/fetch-qt-arm64-sysroot.sh"

[ -e "$QTLIB/libQt5Widgets.so.5" ] || die "sysroot 缺 Qt 运行库: $QTLIB"

command -v moc >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "宿主机没有 moc
  先运行: sudo apt install qtbase5-dev-tools"

MOC_VERSION="$(moc -v 2>&1 | head -1)"
log "宿主机 moc: $MOC_VERSION"

[ -f "$WEAKNET_LIB_DIR/libweaknet.so" ] || die "缺 arm64 libweaknet.so: $WEAKNET_LIB_DIR
  先运行: cmake -B build-arm64-native -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake
          cmake --build build-arm64-native -j\$(nproc)"

command -v clang++ >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "缺 clang++"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 编译
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CXXFLAGS=(
    --target="$TRIPLE"
    --sysroot="$SYSROOT"
    --gcc-toolchain="$SYSROOT/usr"
    -stdlib=libstdc++
    -std=c++17
    -fPIC
    -Wall -Wextra
    -DQT_NO_DEBUG
    -I"$REPO_ROOT/qt_dashboard"
    -I"$REPO_ROOT/client"
    -I"$QTINC"
    -I"$QTINC/QtCore"
    -I"$QTINC/QtGui"
    -I"$QTINC/QtWidgets"
)

LDFLAGS=(
    --target="$TRIPLE"
    --sysroot="$SYSROOT"
    --gcc-toolchain="$SYSROOT/usr"
    -stdlib=libstdc++
)

mkdir -p "$OUT"
cd "$REPO_ROOT/qt_dashboard"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. moc：x86 工具，产物与架构无关
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "生成 moc..."
for h in line_chart_widget data_fetch_thread main_window; do
    moc "ui/$h.hpp" -o "$OUT/moc_$h.cpp" \
        || die "moc 失败: $h"
    log "  moc $h"
done

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 编译（-j1：QEMU/交叉环境下高并行度易出错，且单核即可快速完成）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "编译（串行，避免并行问题）..."
SOURCES=(
    data/json_reader
    data/dashboard_data
    data/data_source
    ui/line_chart_widget
    ui/data_fetch_thread
    ui/main_window
    main
)
OBJECTS=()

for src in "${SOURCES[@]}"; do
    base="$(basename "$src")"
    obj="$OUT/$base.o"
    if ! clang++ "${CXXFLAGS[@]}" -c "$src.cpp" -o "$obj" 2>"$OUT/$base.err"; then
        printf '[build-arm64] 编译失败: %s\n' "$src.cpp" >&2
        head -20 "$OUT/$base.err" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    OBJECTS+=("$obj")
    log "  $base"
done

for m in moc_line_chart_widget moc_data_fetch_thread moc_main_window; do
    obj="$OUT/$m.o"
    if ! clang++ "${CXXFLAGS[@]}" -c "$OUT/$m.cpp" -o "$obj" 2>"$OUT/$m.err"; then
        printf '[build-arm64] 编译失败: %s\n' "$m" >&2
        head -20 "$OUT/$m.err" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    OBJECTS+=("$obj")
    log "  $m"
done

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 链接
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "链接..."
clang++ "${LDFLAGS[@]}" -o "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" "${OBJECTS[@]}" \
    -L"$QTLIB" -lQt5Widgets -lQt5Gui -lQt5Core -lQt5DBus \
    -L"$WEAKNET_LIB_DIR" -lweaknet \
    -Wl,-rpath-link,"$QTLIB" \
    -Wl,-rpath-link,"$SYSROOT/lib/$TRIPLE" \
    || die "链接失败"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 验证产物
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "验证..."
file "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" | sed 's/^/  /'

MAX_GLIBC="$(readelf --version-info "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -o 'GLIBC_[0-9.]*' | sort -uV | tail -1)"
log "最高 glibc 需求: ${MAX_GLIBC:-未知}  （板端是 GLIBC_2.31）"

SIZE="$(stat -c%s "$OUT/weaknet_dashboard")"
log "产物大小: $SIZE 字节"

cat <<EOF

[build-arm64] 完成: $OUT/weaknet_dashboard

部署到开发板：
  scp $OUT/weaknet_dashboard board:/tmp/
  ssh board 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen /tmp/weaknet_dashboard --help'

接显示器后（需要 /dev/dri 权限）：
  ssh board 'sudo QT_QPA_PLATFORM=eglfs /tmp/weaknet_dashboard'
EOF
